summary: TC Energy Corp and TransCanada PipeLines Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing quarterly financial reports (MD&A and interim financial statements) and certifications for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes a news release dated July 30, 2026, and incorporates exhibits by reference into registration statements. This is a routine periodic reporting filing by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. The filing references the completed spinoff of Liquids Pipelines into South Bow Corporation but does not announce a new transaction or change.
